module: Generator of the central surface (the roadway) of a Track Builder track segment. Three section profiles are defined: regular (curved surface and underside), halfRegular and low (simplified version used in low quality). getMeshes computes the normals and returns the mesh extruded along the segment's points.
notes: The profile is chosen by segment.centerMesh; if this name does not exist, getMeshes returns an empty list. If segment.quality == 4, the 'low' profile is forced.
Side effect: increments segment.submeshCount and fills segment.submeshIndexes.
Bug: clearShapes uses ipairs on the shapes table, which is keyed by name (regular, halfRegular, low); the loop therefore never runs and the function clears nothing.

getMeshes.desc: Returns {mesh} for the segment's central surface, or {} if the requested profile does not exist.

segment.desc: Track Builder segment (points, centerMesh, quality, materialInfo, meshInfo, submeshCount, submeshIndexes).

returns.desc: List of at most one mesh table {verts, uvs, normals, faces, material, tag}.

clearShapes.desc: Intended to clear the vertex cache (vertexLUT) of each profile and reset LUTMax/LUTMin. Does nothing in practice (see notes).
